zh.title: AI Agent Workstation
zh.summary: 面向本地多智能体协作的工作区，以结构化交接文件连接 Hermes 的规划与评审和 Codex 的实现与测试，并明确人类负责方向、约束、审批与最终决策。

sections.title: 协作流程
paragraphs: 工作区按模板、任务、结果、评审、记忆候选和可复用工作流组织内容。主要流程依次产出上下文、Codex 任务、执行结果、评审和记忆候选，使规划、实施与复核拥有清晰的交接边界。

sections.title: 角色与安全边界
paragraphs: Hermes 负责规划、协调、评审及上下文和记忆治理；Codex 负责代码修改、测试、构建、调试和结果报告；用户保留产品方向、授权与最终决策。默认规则要求项目与工作流分离存放、避免在交接材料中写入秘密，并在破坏性操作或外部集成前暂停确认。

sections.title: 辅助验证
paragraphs: 在配套辅助层可用时，流程可对任务、结果、评审和记忆候选执行制品质量检查。该辅助层只提供模板和验证能力，不取代可见的 Markdown 流程文档，也不应演变为隐藏自动化。

en.title: AI Agent Workstation
en.summary: A local multi-agent workspace that connects Hermes planning and review with Codex implementation and testing through structured handoff artifacts, while reserving direction, constraints, approvals, and final decisions for the human user.

sections.title: Collaboration Workflow
paragraphs: The workspace organizes templates, tasks, results, reviews, memory candidates, and reusable workflows. Its primary flow produces context, a Codex task, an execution result, a review, and memory candidates in sequence, giving planning, implementation, and verification clear handoff boundaries.

sections.title: Roles and Safety Boundaries
paragraphs: Hermes handles planning, coordination, review, and context and memory hygiene; Codex handles code changes, tests, builds, debugging, and result reports; the user retains product direction, authorization, and final decisions. Defaults separate project repositories from workflow artifacts, prohibit secrets in handoff materials, and require a pause before destructive operations or external integrations.

sections.title: Artifact Validation
paragraphs: When the companion helper layer is available, the workflow can quality-check task, result, review, and memory-candidate artifacts. The helper supplies templates and validation only; it does not replace the visible Markdown workflow or become hidden automation.

zh.title: AI Video Studio
zh.summary: 基于 TypeScript、Next.js 与 Remotion 的 AI 视频工作区。当前主线是从真实主题出发，通过资料研究、证据素材、先语音后定时和专用合成制作视频；可编辑的网页生成器保留为次要产品化路径。

sections.title: Agent Producer 制作路径
paragraphs: 默认流程接收主题或简报，研究资料并优先捕获真实证据；真实捕获失败或不可读时，才记录原因并使用局部来源卡片。随后编写旁白节拍、生成或准备 TTS、盘点已有视觉组件，并组合专用 Remotion 视频供静帧和视频复核。
复用能力遵循从图元、视觉块、专用合成到配方和模板的渐进式提升方式。生成的截图、旁白音频和渲染视频默认保留在本地，不作为源码提交。

sections.title: 网页编辑与生成路径
paragraphs: 次要网页路径采用分阶段的故事板规划、旁白合成、字幕对齐和模板编译流程。它支持整片预览、分段编辑、单段重新生成与本地导出，并以 VideoProject 和 VideoSegment 作为预览、编辑及渲染边界。
生成内容被限制在已注册模板和配方的参数范围内。当前模板覆盖脚本、聚焦展示、数据看板和技术讲解等类型，旁白及字幕由分段数据持有。

sections.title: 实现与运行边界
paragraphs: 项目以 Docker 优先方式运行 Next.js 和 Remotion，并提供本地 TTS、渲染制品、进度跟踪以及进程内并发保护。DeepSeek 用于规划和模板编译；VoxCPM 是 Agent Producer 的默认旁白方案，F5-TTS 可作为显式后备并支持语音克隆。
当前限制包括尚未实现持久化与历史记录，也未开放通用媒体库、广泛的媒体层编辑或单段多模板编排。进程内并发限制不构成多实例部署下的全局锁。

en.title: AI Video Studio
en.summary: An AI-first video workspace built with TypeScript, Next.js, and Remotion. Its primary route produces dedicated videos from real topics using research, evidence assets, TTS-first timing, and custom compositions; an editable web generator remains a secondary productization path.

sections.title: Agent Producer Workflow
paragraphs: The default workflow starts from a topic or brief, researches sources, and attempts to capture real evidence first. If a capture fails or is unreadable, it records the reason before using a localized source-card fallback. It then writes narration beats, generates or prepares TTS, inventories existing visual components, and assembles a dedicated Remotion video for still and video review.

Reusable work is promoted gradually from primitives and visual blocks through dedicated compositions to recipes and templates. Generated screenshots, narration audio, and rendered videos remain local by default rather than being committed as source.

sections.title: Web Editing and Generation Path
paragraphs: The secondary web path uses staged storyboard planning, narration synthesis, caption alignment, and template compilation. It supports full-project preview, segment editing, selected-segment regeneration, and local export, with VideoProject and VideoSegment serving as the preview, editing, and rendering boundaries.

Generated output is bounded by registered template and recipe parameters. Current template families cover scripted scenes, spotlights, data dashboards, and technical explainers, while narration and captions are owned by segment data.

sections.title: Implementation and Runtime Boundaries
paragraphs: The project uses a Docker-first Next.js and Remotion setup with local TTS, render artifacts, progress tracking, and process-local concurrency guards. DeepSeek handles planning and template compilation; VoxCPM is the default Agent Producer narration option, while F5-TTS is an explicit fallback with voice-cloning support.

Persistence and history are not implemented, and broad media-library editing, generic media-layer composition, and multiple templates per segment remain out of scope. The process-local concurrency guard is not a global lock across multiple application instances.

zh.title: Spatial：递归智能界面
zh.summary: 一个以中文叙事为主的空间化 AI 原生个人主页，通过长滚动、固定 WebGL 画布和单一递归巨石，呈现观察、因果、递归、自指与重构五个阶段。

sections.title: 空间叙事体验
paragraphs: 页面使用 500svh 长滚动表面和固定的全屏 WebGL 画布。五个叙事阶段分别改变文案布局、相机姿态与材质响应，使体验围绕同一个递归巨石展开，而不是作为传统简历或项目索引。
视觉语言强调建筑感、克制和低饱和双色对比。相机通过环绕、推拉、升降、注视点漂移和滚转塑造接近空间物体的感觉，背景和叙事层则由 CSS 管理。

sections.title: 交互与渲染架构
paragraphs: 项目基于 Next.js、React、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS 和 Three.js。Lenis 与 ScrollTrigger 统一滚动时间线，Motion 处理叙事段落的出现状态，Zustand 保存共享指针、视口与场景模式；自定义逐帧循环协调 DOM、指针和 WebGL 状态。
WebGL 对象固定在世界空间中，滚动驱动相机路径与材质参数，而不是物理房间、重力或碰撞。场景采用单个 React Three Fiber Canvas，并在字体和模型就绪后完成预载界面到正文的过渡。

sections.title: 设计边界
paragraphs: 当前焦点是单一 GLB 递归巨石及其阶段化材质效果，不包含刚体物理场景，也不使用 UI 组件库。Tailwind CSS 继续承担设计系统层，严格 TypeScript 用于约束实现。

en.title: Spatial: Recursive Intelligence Interface
en.summary: A Chinese-first spatial, AI-native personal homepage that uses long-form scrolling, a fixed WebGL canvas, and a single recursive monolith to express five stages: observation, causality, recursion, self-reference, and reconstruction.

sections.title: Spatial Narrative Experience
paragraphs: The page uses a 500svh scrolling surface with a fixed full-screen WebGL canvas. Each of five narrative stages changes copy placement, camera posture, and material response, keeping the experience centered on one recursive monolith rather than presenting a conventional résumé or project index.

Its visual language emphasizes architectural composition, restraint, and low-saturation two-color contrast. Orbit, dolly, height, look-at drift, and roll make scrolling feel like movement around and toward a spatial artifact, while CSS owns the background and narrative layers.

sections.title: Interaction and Rendering Architecture
paragraphs: The project uses Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Three.js. Lenis and ScrollTrigger coordinate the scroll timeline, Motion supplies narrative-presence primitives, Zustand stores shared pointer, viewport, and scene-mode state, and a custom frame loop coordinates DOM, pointer, and WebGL updates.

The WebGL object remains fixed in world space while scrolling drives the camera path and material parameters; there is no active physics room, gravity, or collision system. A single React Three Fiber canvas renders the scene, with a preload transition that waits for fonts and the model before revealing the narrative.

sections.title: Design Boundaries
paragraphs: The current experience is centered on one GLB recursive monolith and its stage-aware material effects. It does not use a UI component kit or a rigid-body scene; Tailwind CSS remains the design-system layer, with strict TypeScript constraining the implementation.

zh.title: webgl-scroll：可组合的 WebGL 滚动效果
zh.summary: 面向 React、Next.js 与智能体前端工作流的可组合 WebGL 滚动效果工具包，提供分层核心运行时、内置效果和 React 触发器，并支持按视口距离调度生命周期及由宿主协调资源预取。

sections.title: 解决的问题与方案
paragraphs: 项目旨在减少滚动驱动 WebGL 页面中的重复集成工作。应用可通过声明式触发器组合效果，而底层运行时负责效果注册、状态、共享指针输入和 GPU 辅助能力。

sections.title: 包结构与内置效果
paragraphs: 项目分为核心引擎、内置效果和 React 绑定。内置效果包括图像、视频与 GLB 资源层，WebGL 标题淡入，基于 GLB 表面采样的指针响应粒子，以及像素化全屏转场。React 组件会输出触发器元数据。

sections.title: 生命周期与资源加载
paragraphs: 效果可依据其与视口的距离预加载、暂停和卸载，并限制并发预加载数量。配置既可全局设置，也可在触发器或单个效果层级覆盖。宿主还可提供资源解析器，并从效果声明生成内置资源的预加载清单。

sections.title: 职责边界与状态
paragraphs: 宿主应用仍需负责画布初始化、渲染循环和清理，也可以统一管理资源下载。README 将 0.1.0 描述为首个公开发行系列；其中提及的生命周期调度和宿主资源预取改动仍位于开发分支，后续发布尚待合并与发版。

en.title: webgl-scroll: Composable WebGL Scroll Effects
en.summary: A composable WebGL scroll-effects toolkit for React, Next.js, and agentic frontend workflows. It combines a layered core runtime, built-in effects, React triggers, viewport-distance lifecycle scheduling, and hooks for host-managed asset prefetching.

sections.title: Problem and Approach
paragraphs: The project aims to reduce repeated integration work in scroll-driven WebGL pages. Applications can compose effects through declarative triggers, while the lower-level runtime provides effect registration, state, shared pointer input, and GPU helpers.

sections.title: Packages and Built-in Effects
paragraphs: The project is divided into a core engine, built-in effects, and React bindings. Its effects cover image, video, and GLB asset layers; fading WebGL titles; pointer-responsive particles sampled from GLB surfaces; and pixelated fullscreen transitions. React components emit trigger metadata.

sections.title: Lifecycle and Asset Loading
paragraphs: Effects can preload, suspend, and unload according to their distance from the viewport, with a limit on concurrent preload work. Settings may be overridden globally, per trigger, or per effect. Hosts can also supply an asset resolver and derive a preload manifest from built-in effect declarations.

sections.title: Responsibilities and Status
paragraphs: The host application remains responsible for canvas setup, the render loop, and teardown, and may manage downloads centrally. The README identifies 0.1.0 as the first public release line; the described lifecycle scheduling and host-prefetch changes remain on a development branch pending a later merge and package release.

zh.title: Hero Next 双语个人网站
zh.summary: 一个基于 Next.js App Router、React Three Fiber 与 Three.js 的独立双语个人网站，整合个人简介、理念文章、项目案例、公开渠道和日志，并针对桌面沉浸式浏览与移动端阅读提供不同布局。

sections.title: 内容与浏览体验
paragraphs: 网站以四个章节呈现个人简介、AI 与哲学理念、公开项目及公开渠道，随后展示按日期组织的日志。中英文内容由类型化数据共享，并保存语言、主题和项目房间选择。
宽屏精细指针设备使用圆形文章索引、动态纸张、四面项目展厅和透视日志；移动端、触控设备及较矮的横屏窗口则采用完整文本、紧凑列表和原生折叠控件组成的阅读布局。

sections.title: 交互与技术架构
paragraphs: 项目维持单一运行时、Canvas 和滚动源，以 React Three Fiber 管理渲染与帧循环，并结合 WebGL 四面体、面投影、三角形过渡、GLB 模型和光照。语义化 DOM 布局、无障碍颜色、层叠与指针路由由 CSS 负责。
主题与语言使用独立的持久化状态。页面支持减少动态效果，并为普通文本保持至少 4.5:1 的对比度；移动阅读布局提供持续可用的主题按钮。

sections.title: 项目目录与机器可读内容
paragraphs: 项目包含四篇完整的双语精选案例，也可将经过校验的公开仓库数据加入项目目录。案例既能在展厅中以原生阅读对话框打开，也能通过独立页面呈现。
服务器渲染的 Agent 目录与 Markdown 文档覆盖个人资料、理念、项目和日志，内容由现有类型化数据及已验证的日志快照在构建期间生成，无需维护另一套文案。日志必须在首次开发或构建前同步。

sections.title: 边界与限制
paragraphs: 实现仅使用 Viselora 的公开入口，并固定相关依赖版本。开发环境的宽松主机允许列表只适用于受信任网络，不应将开发端口暴露到公网。
README 指出 Canvas 与 DOM 的字形栅格化仍可能略有差异，现有内容也是可继续编辑的基础版本。自动化覆盖、交互证据和剩余诊断记录在项目状态文档中。

en.title: Hero Next Bilingual Personal Site
en.summary: A standalone bilingual personal site built with the Next.js App Router, React Three Fiber, and Three.js. It combines a profile, essays, project cases, public channels, and a journal, with distinct experiences for immersive desktop browsing and mobile reading.

sections.title: Content and browsing experience
paragraphs: The site presents a profile, AI and philosophy axioms, public projects, and public channels across four chapters, followed by a date-based journal. Chinese and English share typed content, while locale, theme, and project-room selection are persisted.

Wide screens with a fine pointer use a circular article index, moving sheets, a four-wall project room, and a perspective journal. Mobile, touch, and short landscape windows switch to a reading layout with complete text, compact lists, and native disclosures.

sections.title: Interaction and architecture
paragraphs: The project keeps one runtime, canvas, and scroll source. React Three Fiber manages rendering and the frame loop for a WebGL tetrahedron, face projection, triangular transitions, a GLB model, and lighting, while CSS handles semantic DOM layout, accessible colors, stacking, and pointer routing.

Theme and locale use separate persistent stores. The experience supports reduced motion and targets at least 4.5:1 contrast for normal text; the mobile reading layout keeps a theme control available throughout the page.

sections.title: Project catalog and machine-readable content
paragraphs: The project includes four complete bilingual featured case studies and can add validated public repository data to its project directory. Cases can open in a native reading dialog over the exhibition room or render as standalone pages.

A server-rendered Agent directory and Markdown documents cover the profile, axioms, projects, and journal. They are generated during the build from existing typed content and a validated journal snapshot rather than maintained as separate copy. Journal data must be synchronized before the first development session or build.

sections.title: Boundaries and limitations
paragraphs: The implementation consumes only public Viselora entrypoints and pins the relevant package versions. Its permissive development hostname allowlist is intended only for trusted networks, and the development port should not be exposed publicly.

The README notes that Canvas and DOM glyph rasterization may still differ slightly, and the current content is a base version intended for further editing. Automated coverage, interaction evidence, and remaining diagnostics are maintained in the project's status documentation.

zh.title: Viselora 智能体技能
zh.summary: 面向 Viselora DOM/WebGL 运行时的智能体技能，用于构建、迁移和调试由语义化 DOM 与 React Three Fiber / Three.js 场景协同驱动的页面。

sections.title: 项目概述
paragraphs: 该项目提供 Viselora 相关的智能体技能，服务于 React 19 和 Next.js 中语义化 DOM 与单一 React Three Fiber / Three.js WebGL 场景同步的开发场景。

sections.title: 适用场景
paragraphs: 所含技能可用于让 WebGL 或 3D 视觉跟随 DOM 元素、将 DOM 文本转换为纹理，以及构建由滚动交互驱动的 3D 场景；其目标技术包括 @viselora/dom-webgl 和 @viselora/scroll-adapters。

sections.title: 生成与维护
paragraphs: 此仓库由上游工作区的 skills 目录生成，并非独立源代码来源；直接在此处所做的更改可能会在重新生成时被覆盖。

en.title: Viselora Agent Skills
en.summary: Agent skills for the Viselora DOM/WebGL runtime, supporting pages where semantic DOM and a React Three Fiber / Three.js scene work together.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: This project packages agent skills for Viselora workflows that synchronize semantic DOM with a single React Three Fiber / Three.js WebGL scene in React 19 and Next.js.

sections.title: Use Cases
paragraphs: The included skill covers building, migrating, and debugging pages where WebGL or 3D visuals follow DOM elements, DOM text becomes textures, or scrolling drives a 3D scene. It targets @viselora/dom-webgl and @viselora/scroll-adapters.

sections.title: Generation and Maintenance
paragraphs: This is a generated repository sourced from the upstream workspace's skills directory rather than an independent source of changes. Direct modifications may be overwritten when it is regenerated.
